scorecard.title: ACCP Auto Routing v2 PlanSpec Generation

template_conformance.notes: PlanSpec follows PlanSpec v5 alpha2 template structure exactly. All top-level sections present: metadata, compatibility, intent, authority, enforcementRegistry, security, commands, locking, brief, waves, workspaces, validation, evidence, reports, p45Bridge, renderHints, migration.

vision_requirement_coverage.notes: All 12 requirements (REQ-001 through REQ-012) from the vision document are encoded in the PlanSpec. Hard requirements, anti-patterns, and operator notes cover the full vision scope.

internal_type_mapping_quality.notes: All 24 internal ACCP report types are accounted for. The mapping sources from the authoritative ACCP_REPORT_REGISTRY rather than hardcoding. Corrections applied: BSR to Repair/Debug, FPR to Repair/Debug, ECR excluded from critical bugfix chain between FVR and PRR.

hard_stop_registry_quality.notes: Full 16 hard stops (HS-001 through HS-016) defined with condition, blocked action, required action, severity, and diagnostic code. Coverage spans PlanLock enforcement, verify evidence, bugfix chains, wave gates, route safety, auto-routing safety, Expert/Direct safety, chain order, and chain length limits.

multi_intent_and_bugfix_chain_quality.notes: Three bugfix chains defined (small, unknown, critical) with 5 feedback loops. Multi-intent decomposition with canonical phase order and conditional Repair detour. Each phase independently hard-gated.

tui_and_ux_plan_quality.notes: Four TUI workspaces cover default Auto display, low-confidence picker, Expert grouped picker, chain progress, and Abort/Reroute controls. -1: TUI keybindings are placeholders (Esc/Tab); final bindings deferred to configurable keybinding system in implementation.

test_matrix_quality.notes: Complete test matrix with unit tests, integration tests, negative tests, live tests, and drift test. Hard stop coverage requires at least one triggering and one non-triggering test per HS-001..HS-016.

evidence_schema_quality.notes: Route decision evidence schema defined with 14 fields, hashability, auditability, and replayability. -3: The exact JSON schema definition is deferred to implementation workspace P49.14.03; PlanSpec describes requirements but not the formal schema structure.

warnings: TUI keybindings (Esc for Abort, Tab for Reroute) are placeholder defaults. Implementation should integrate with the configurable keybinding system defined in packages/coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts.
Route decision evidence JSON schema is described in requirements but the formal schema definition is deferred to workspace P49.14.03 implementation.
scorecard.next_recommended_phase: P49.14B — ACCP Auto Routing v2 Implementation
scorecard.notes: P49.14 is planning-only. This PlanSpec is the primary output. P49.14B should implement from this PlanSpec. The PlanSpec defines 16 workspaces across 4 waves. All hard stops passed. Score of 96/100 is above the 90-point execute_ready threshold.
